title: Public comments on items (signed-in, threaded, moderated)
description:
As a signed-in reader, I want to comment on an item and reply to others, so that discussion improves the record.

Notes: new message kind for reader comments (the existing staff message model is private); approved or visible comments are projected to public JSON per item; comment counts are shown only when comments exist. Subject to the moderation mode. Board and item pages must look finished with comments off.

```gherkin
Feature: Comments
  Scenario: Post
    Given a signed-in reader on an item with comments enabled
    When the reader posts a comment
    Then it is visible according to the moderation mode

  Scenario: Reply
    When the reader replies to a comment
    Then the reply is threaded under the parent

  Scenario: Comments off
    Given a publication with comments disabled
    Then no comment control or count is rendered

  Scenario: Guests read only
    Then guests can read visible comments but cannot post
```
